'''John Kaufeld''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 49 from Fishers, IN.<ref name="sm-fan" /> His slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" /> At DecipherCon 1999 Kaufeld also played [[Young Jedi]]: finished 28 in Young Jedi World Championship (Open Champs); finished 7 in YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck).<ref name="dc99yj05_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ05_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Young Jedi World Championship (Open Champs)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010105010700/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ05_1.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99yj02_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108185300/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html Internet Archive]</ref>

He was hired to write an official strategy guide for the game, but the publisher folded before it was finished. He ran the monthly "Vineyard" tournament in Indianapolis, with 30 to 40 regular players, and wrote ''For Dummies'' books.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Kaufeld is thanked in the credits of the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] rulebook (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref> Decipher sent him the draft rules in October 2000 for an outsider's view; he urged a card almanac.<ref name="jkd102600">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/designdiary/entries/102600.html Design Diary, 26 October 2000], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001208002600/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/designdiary/entries/102600.html Internet Archive]</ref>
